sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: PCT Patent Application and International Trademark Registration

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: DTAAs: Luxembourg-United States (as amended by the 2009 Protocol), Luxembourg-Germany, Luxembourg-France, Luxembourg-Netherlands, Luxembourg-China, Luxembourg-United Kingdom
BLEU bilateral investment treaties concluded by the Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union, including BLEU-China and BLEU-Hong Kong SAR
Luxembourg is a founding EU Member State; free movement of capital, services and establishment applies under the TFEU; relevant IP conventions include the PCT, EPC and Madrid Protocol

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 and Law of 25 March 2020 establishing the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Law of 23 July 2016 introducing the SCSp; CSSF Regulation 12-02 and applicable CSSF Circulars; EU Regulations (EU) No 269/2014 and (EU) No 2580/2001 on restrictive measures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: SCSp limited partnership agreement (contrat de société) executed as acte sous seing privé with legalized signatures or as a notarial deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg civil-law notary or foreign signatories of the partnership agreement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the deed is executed outside Luxembourg; domestic notarization for Luxembourg-executed deeds

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing and memorandum of the foreign ultimate corporate shareholder of the SCSp
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or chamber of commerce in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague states, consular legalization by the Luxembourg Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered-office consent letter (lettre de domiciliation) from the licensed domiciliation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg corporate domiciliation provider approved under the Law of 31 May 1999
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic issuance; Hague Apostille only required where the consent letter is executed and certified abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and proof-of-address of each individual ultimate beneficial owner, with certified translation into French, German or English
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing state authority or Luxembourg sworn translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the underlying public identity documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence performed before incorporation: verification of the identity and address of every UBO holding more than 25% of capital or voting rights or otherwise exercising control; screening against the RBE register, EU restrictive measures under Regulations (EU) No 269/2014 and (EU) No 2580/2001, the UN consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list and domestic PEP databases; enhanced due diligence and senior-management sign-off for any PEP exposure; event-driven re-screening and a mandatory 12-month re-screening cycle for the client file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) electronic filing and name-clearance portal (www.lbr.lu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed business name must be written in Latin script and be readable in at least one of the three administrative languages of Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish); English terms are acceptable only if not misleading and consistently transcribed; for an SCSp the name must be followed by the legal-form suffix 'SCSp', 'S.C.Sp.' or 'Société en commandite spéciale'; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing RCS registered name and must not falsely suggest a regulated activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Luxembourg (where the name falsely implies royal, ministerial or state patronage)
Patent Attorney / Conseil en Propriété Industrielle (use without ILPI registration is prohibited)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal by the RCS on identity or confusion grounds, the applicant first files a written re-evaluation request with the RCS name-clearance office, attaching the negative-certificate dossier, evidence of non-confusion and corrected particulars; if the refusal is maintained, the applicant may within one month from notification bring an administrative appeal before the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg (chambre commerciale) under the applicable provisions of the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, requesting the court to order registration of the name; where the refusal relates to a sensitive token, prior ministerial or ILPI authorization must be obtained before filing the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office without physical presence in Luxembourg is not permissible. The SCSp must maintain a genuine registered office in Luxembourg, either owned, leased, or supplied by a licensed domiciliation agent under the Law of 31 May 1999; the registered-office consent letter must be kept on file at the RCS address. For the IP patent-prosecution agency activity, the RCS, Ministry of the Economy and ILPI substance expectations require a physical administrative seat in Luxembourg where client records, principal register books and patent correspondence are stored and accessible on demand.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: The quantified likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by the RCS, RBE control authorities or the CSSF is Low, estimated at approximately 5-8% probability in any given financial year for a low-risk standard IP agency held through an SCSp; the likelihood increases materially if the registered office is supplied by an unlicensed domiciliation provider or if AML/CFT red flags arise.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS name-clearance request and negative certificate of non-confusion for the SCSp business name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the Luxembourg Business Registers fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the Luxembourg Business Registers fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Compulsory publication of the incorporation extract in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal officiel du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg (Luxembourg Official Journal)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: LBR RBE online beneficial-owner register filing for the UBOs of the SCSp (electronic filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee exemption; the filing is executed electronically through the LBR portal without charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of the RBE declaration and UBO documentation pack by the Luxembourg corporate law firm or fiduciary agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg corporate law firm / regulated fiduciary agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of foreign corporate and identity documents (certificate of incorporation, good standing, powers of attorney, UBO passports)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Origin-country apostille authority / Luxembourg consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular market benchmark per document bundle (approximately EUR 20-60 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the SCSp limited partnership agreement in bilingual French/English with capital-structure and UBO clauses
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for a standard non-regulated services partnership

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence pack: OFAC, UN, EU sanctions and PEP screening plus UBO identity verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark subscription and bundle fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation for the SCSp for the first quarter, including consent letter, mail handling and register-file hosting
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (Law of 31 May 1999)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark quarterly fee supervised by the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident manager and initial commercial-substance service for the patent-prosecution agency activities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed set-up charge and first-month retainer

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, especially Part III (Arts. 25-1 through 25-21) on the Société en Commandite Spéciale; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 23 January 2020 concerning the business register.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), Registry of Commerce and Companies (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – RCS), supervised by the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Contrat de société / Statuts) executed by all partners and filed with the RCS; the deed may be by private signature, unless the partnership holds real estate requiring a notarial deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None: the SCSp has no statutory minimum capital and no paid-up capital or escrow requirement. Partners may agree actual contributions and timelines exclusively in the partnership agreement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of [●] partnership interests in the Société en Commandite Spéciale be and is hereby accepted, and allotment is recorded with effect from [●]. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be and is hereby fixed at [●], Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, and the Articles of Association initialled by the partners are approved. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Manager (Gérant) with sole signatory authority to represent the partnership in all commercial, banking, regulatory, and administrative matters. The Manager is authorized to complete all filings with the Luxembourg Business Registers, publish required statutory notices, and obtain any permits required for the conduct of the patent prosecution business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RCS online consultation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Perform a search on the RCS name database and the Luxembourg intellectual property office database to confirm the proposed SCSp name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity or trademark. Reserve the name by pre-filing the intended name at the RCS electronic counter; the reservation is not itself a registration but provides priority while assembling the file.
required_dossiers: Certificate of non-infringement / search result printout
Intended corporate or partnership object description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on grounds of conflict, submit an alternative name or petition the RCS with evidence of consent from the prior rights holder, or file a formal objection under Article 20 of the Law of 10 August 1915.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary or self-execution in accordance with the SCSp provisions of the Law of 10 August 1915
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association containing the SCSp statutory minimum content: name, registered office address, object (ISIC 7490 / patent prosecution services), duration, identity and share of each partner (general and limited), liability clause, contribution arrangements, and management powers. Execute the deed either by private signature of all partners or by notarial act if future real estate contribution is anticipated.
required_dossiers: Certified translations in French, German, or English (as appropriate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Civil law defects in the deed may be cured by an amending deed (acte rectificatif); tax registration overlays do not invalidate the partnership but require identified corrective filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Partner Bank Account Opening and Contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chosen commercial bank in Luxembourg (e.g., BIL, BGL BNP Paribas, Société Générale) or European Economic Area credit institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a partnership current account in the SCSp name; provide the executed Articles, partner identification, and a compliance declaration confirming that the partnership is not a tax-transparent structure subject to Luxembourg corporate income tax. Make formal subcriptions and, if agreed, pay the agreed capital contributions toward the partnership bank account; then obtain a certified proof of contribution for the RCS file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes a reputational risk review, provide a detailed business plan, source-of-wealth statements for partners, and the ISIC 7490 professional engagement pipeline; otherwise apply to another Luxembourg bank using the same dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RCS Electronic Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RCS application form (Formulaire pour sociétés en commandite spéciale). Submit electronically: executed Articles of Association, the application for registration, identification of the Gérant and partners, a declaration of non-bankruptcy, and the proof of contribution or statement that no capital is required. The RCS will register the SCSp and assign a RCS number.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of the Gérant
Declaration of good conduct and non-insolvency
Proof of registered office authorisation (if premises are non-owned)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RCS raises a query regarding the deed or ability of the Gérant, the applicant must respond through the electronic interface within one month by filing a corrective instrument or clarifying the particular legal capacity; failure to cure leads to rejection without prejudice to a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Company Gazette (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RESA publication system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following RCS registration, the RCS automatically causes the statutory extracts to be published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA). Verify the publication within 10 days and update firm communication, contracts, and regulatory filing references with the RCS registration number and LEI (if required).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published extract contains inaccuracy, the RCS must be notified within 15 days and an amended publication is issued upon payment of the correction fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy – Directorate-General for Sectoral Policy, Intellectual Property and Innovation (Ministère de l'Économie, Direction générale de l'industrie et de la propriété intellectuelle)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Professional authorisation for industrial property advice and patent prosecution services (Autorisation d'exercice en conseil en propriété industrielle) jointly applicable to the firm and its qualified patent attorneys

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Environmental Protection Agency, Luxembourg)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Declaration (Catégorie D – simple notification), not a full EIA, because the activity is exclusively professional office services with no industrial production or discharge processes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater discharge; municipal sewage discharge must conform to municipal wastewater bylaws (sewage regulation). Severely limited VOC emissions (office printing and cleaning products) must remain below 1 tonne per year, requiring no operator permit. Waste handling, including paper and electronic equipment, must conform to the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management and the obligation to use authorised collectors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance certificate issued by the Commune (municipal authority) based on inspection by the Corps Grand-Ducal d'Incendie et de Secours (CGDIS), verifying building occupancy limits, exits, and portable fire extinguishers; structural load clearance and access compliance from the municipal building department; and a workplace health and safety clearance issued by the labour inspectorate (Inspection du Travail et des Mines) covering equipment, workstation ergonomics, and first-aid provisions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT. Single digital portal: MyGuichet.lu (https://guichet.public.lu) and Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) for entity and tax identification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Reserve the SCSp name and file incorporation document (private deed sufficient unless real property is contributed) with the Luxembourg Business Registers; obtain the RCS registration number (Numéro d'immatriciation) and the national business identification number. Step 2: Enroll for corporate income tax / municipal business tax (if any) and net wealth tax identification with ACD. Step 3: File VAT registration application with AEDT via MyGuichet.lu to obtain a Luxembourg VAT number in format 'LU' + 8 digits; a non-resident SCSp without Luxembourg establishment must register directly for VAT once it makes taxable supplies in Luxembourg and may be required to appoint a VAT fiscal representative if established outside the EU. Step 4: Apply for an EORI number through the Luxembourg Customs and Excise Agency for any export/import operations. The SCSp, although transparent for direct tax, acts as a distinct VAT taxable person for its economic activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg grants no formal check-the-box regime. However, an SCSp is tax transparent by default; certain partnerships may elect to be treated as a capital company for Luxembourg income tax purposes under Article 2(2) of the Income Tax Law (option de transparence). Hybrid mismatch elections and aligned status classifications are available under ATAD-driven Luxembourg rules (Article 168quater LIR). For VAT, no transparency election exists: the SCSp is a taxable person if it independently carries out an economic activity, irrespective of its direct-tax transparency.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for the domestic small-enterprise exemption (in force from 1 January 2025); non-resident suppliers without Luxembourg establishment have no threshold and must register from the first taxable supply; the threshold does not apply to intra-Community distance sales or B2C electronic services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No general real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate for B2B invoices. E-invoicing is mandatory for B2G transactions via the Peppol network; B2B e-invoicing is optional but must be processed if issued. VAT returns must be submitted electronically through the eCDF channel (XML file) via MyGuichet.lu, with monthly, quarterly, or annual filing cycles depending on turnover. Data retention of e-invoices (authenticity, integrity, legibility) is required for 10 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under Article 43 of the Luxembourg VAT Law for goods physically exported to destinations outside the EU. For services such as PCT patent prosecution and international trademark registration, the place of supply rule makes B2B services to non-Luxembourg taxable customers taxable where the customer is established (reverse charge), effectively 0% Luxembourg VAT. B2C services relating to intellectual property, consultancy, and legal/prosecution services to non-EU customers are outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT under Article 59(c) of the VAT Directive if actually used outside the EU, provided the supplier obtains and retains sufficient evidence of the customer's non-EU status and effective use. All zero-rating requires contemporaneous documentary substantiation of the export or the offshore recipient status.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/DAU or electronic declaration via Luxembourg DELTA-C system)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / CMR
Inward Remittance Certificate (SWIFT MT103 or bank statement evidencing foreign-source payment)
Commercial invoice and engagement contract with the foreign patent applicant
Receiving office / patent office filing confirmation and official PCT fee receipts
Certificate of foreign VAT registration or VIES validation for the non-resident business customer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT heavily scrutinizes zero-rated export claims. If documentation is incomplete or fraudulent, the authority issues a clawback assessment for the unpaid VAT plus default interest (statutory monthly interest of 0.8%), and applies civil penalties ranging from EUR 750 to EUR 12,500 per infraction. Intentional false declarations (fraude fiscale) expose the taxpayer to criminal fines up to EUR 50,000 and imprisonment up to five years, with an extended 10-year assessment window for fraudulent or non-filed cases (standard assessment period: 5 years). In cross-border patent prosecution structures, mischaracterization of services as exported when effectively used in Luxembourg triggers full VAT recovery plus interest and penalties from the date the tax should have been declared.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) — Eurosystem member holding monetary authority and Balance-of-Payments (BOP) statistics mandate; Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) supervises credit institutions, payment institutions, and e-money institutions; no separate Foreign Exchange Administration exists in Luxembourg.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: EUR is national legal tender; Luxembourg imposes zero exchange controls. Both current and capital account transactions are fully liberalized under Article 63 TFEU; no FX licensing, prior authorization, or transaction declaration applies to service receipts, patent annuity payments, or capital injections into an SCSp. Profit remittance is unhindered: the SCSp is tax-transparent (unless an election for opacity is made), so distributions to resident or non-resident partners carry no Luxembourg withholding tax and no government approval is required for cross-border transfers. Practical hurdle: banks automatically report cross-border wire transfers of EUR 12,500 or more to BCL for BOP survey purposes under the client's IFR (Inward/Outward) classification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Luxembourg has no export-proceeds surrender, retention, compulsory conversion, or minimum holding period for commercial earnings denominated in EUR, USD, CHF, or other currencies. Incoming USD/CHF receipts from PCT filings, WIPO annuities, or foreign associate invoices may be retained in foreign-currency accounts indefinitely; conversion into EUR is voluntary and subject only to bank spread and ordinary counterparty credit terms.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (EUR/USD/CHF) plus segregated client-money escrow sub-ledger
Operational current account (EUR and USD sweeping) with dedicated EPO deposit-account transfer capability
Operational account and capital escrow account (partitioned sub-accounts for unit capital calls and client funds)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EUR account only; foreign-currency sub-ledgers subject to separate credit approval
Operational digital account (EUR/USD); escrow and client-money accounts restricted to existing institutional relationships

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium — legally viable but operationally constrained. CSSF-licensed EMIs (e.g., PPRO Financial S.A.) and passporting EMIs such as Wise Europe S.A. can open payment accounts for an SCSp provided the LPA, RCS extract, RBE certificate, and UBO declarations pass the EMI's KYB engine. Legal constraints: (i) a PSD2 payment account is not a regulated banking current account and cannot hold patent-attorney client funds under the Luxembourg séquestre regime; (ii) Wise's Acceptable Use Policy prohibits businesses acting as trust, fiduciary, or third-party payment intermediaries, so the SCSp may use Wise only for its own operational disbursements supported by direct invoices; (iii) EMIs offer no FX forward, overdraft, or documentary credit capabilities; (iv) transaction ceilings and mid-market conversion make Wise suboptimal for annuity batches exceeding EUR 25,000 per operation. Recommended scope: low-value disbursements below USD 2,000 to WIPO, USPTO, and foreign associates; all client-money and high-value treasury flows must be routed through Tier-1 commercial banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory in practice: the General Partner (GP) or an authorized managing partner of the SCSp must attend a face-to-face onboarding interview in Luxembourg before account activation. Remote opening is permitted under the Law of 25 March 2020 transposing EU AMLD5, but only with CSSF-compliant video-identification and enhanced due diligence (two independent identity documents, registered-office verification via RCS extract, and origin-of-funds statements). Luxembourg registered office and active RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) registration are contractual preconditions; no minimum local payroll is required for account opening, but FATCA/CRS self-certification of the SCSp and each substantial partner is obligatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp legal form used for a fee-based service business — transparent partnership with zero minimum capital flagged as possible money-laundering shell
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Limited Partnership Agreement (duly authenticated), RCS extract, RBE certificate, ownership and GP-control chain, detailed business plan for patent prosecution, statutory professional license (Conseil en Propriété Industrielle) of the managing attorney, sample client retainer and annuity invoices, and three-year cash-flow projection

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: GP, UBOs, or capital-contributing partners resident outside the EEA, triggering non-face-to-face red flags and correspondent bank scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OECD-format passport copies, apostilled proof of address dated within 3 months, corporate extract of the corporate GP with register authenticity, authority resolution appointing the account signatories, FATCA/CRS tax identification numbers of all partners, and source-of-wealth declaration for the initial contribution

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Co-mingling of client patent-annuity funds with operating cash in the same account, raising fiduciary misuse concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client-money segregation policy under the Luxembourg Luxembourg legal-professional and IP-attorney escrow rules; separate ledger accounting entries; external accountant's attestation; signed client mandates authorizing the agency to pay official fees to EPO, USPTO, and WIPO

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound payments from high-risk jurisdictions or opaque IP-holding shell companies financing PCT national-phase entries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds chronology: engagement letter with foreign associate, underlying patent assignment or licence deeds, original invoices bearing EPO/USPTO/WIPO filing references, remitter's bank statements, remitter's corporate register extract, and notarized translations into French, English, or German

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: executing partners send a SEPA Credit Transfer (pain.001) or SWIFT MT103 to the SCSp's designated account; beneficiary name and registered address must match the RCS entry exactly. Remittance information (field 70) must state 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — SCSp AGREEMENT [DATE] — UNIT CLASS [X]' with ISO 20022 external purpose code 'INVS' (investments, excluding cash). Verification: the bank archives the LPA signature page, the unit subscription ledger, the GP-issued capital-call notice, and partner identification; BCL BOP automatic reporting classifies the inflow as F511 (direct investment — equity capital other than reinvested earnings). No FX conversion is mandatory; if the contribution arrives in USD or CHF, the bank may credit the foreign-currency sub-account or convert at prevailing market rates upon client instruction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: EUR settlement to the European Patent Office: SWIFT MT103 or MT102 clearing via TARGET2 to the EPO treasury account, with field 70 containing the EPO deposit-account number and application/publication reference; intraday execution confirms official-fee timing. USD settlement to the USPTO: MT103 routed over CHIPS via the bank's US correspondent, beneficiary being the USPTO fee-collection account, with 'OVRDT' waiver instructions where permissible. CHF settlement to WIPO in Geneva: via SIC or the bank's CHF clearing correspondent using MT103 with WIPO account reference. For foreign patent associates, documentary rails are limited to SBLC (SWIFT MT760) or on-demand bank guarantees for milestone annuities; a documentary Letter of Credit (MT700) is used only for portfolio annuity acquisitions and requires presentation of pro-forma invoices plus EPO/WIPO filing receipts as the prescribed document matrix.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD outright forwards (1M-12M tenors) under the bank's ISDA 2002 or short-form FX Master Agreement, permitted as commercial hedging of US patent prosecution and USPTO renewal fee exposure
EUR/CHF outright forwards for WIPO annuity and trademark renewal disbursements — CHF is freely deliverable in Luxembourg, so NDF is not required
FX swaps (swap-in/swap-out) for rolling USD receipts into EUR without realizing open FX risk in the annuity treasury float

Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR) for netting multi-year PCT portfolio cost streams — permissible under CSSF/EMIR rules with trade reporting and, only if the SCSp exceeds EMIR clearing thresholds, mandatory central clearing; NDFs are legally available solely for residual non-deliverable currencies (e.g., INR, IDR) not applicable to the EUR/USD/CHF core

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS Annual Confirmation (Déclaration Annuelle de Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of the SCSp's initial RCS registration; the annual confirmation may be filed between one month before and one month after such anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-imposed fine of up to EUR 150 per default (Article 19, Law of 19 December 2002); two consecutive years of non-filing triggers administrative strike-off (radiation d'office) from the RCS and loss of registered legal standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Register Annual Confirmation (Confirmation Annuelle du Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of the most recent UBO declaration; within one month of any change in beneficial ownership, including transfers of partnership interests in the SCSp
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: General partner exposed to criminal fines of EUR 1,250 to EUR 1,250,000 and/or imprisonment from six months to five years for false or omitted declarations; administrative fine up to EUR 500 and public non-compliance mention on the RBE register for persistent default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing with the RCS (applicable only if the SCSp has opted for legal personality or exceeds the accounting exemption thresholds)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) via Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) e-filing platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the financial year for approval by partners and filing with the RCS within one month after that approval; for a calendar-year SCSp, approval by 30 June and filing by 31 December of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered fine from EUR 150 to EUR 1,500 per financial year of late filing; repeated default may lead to judicial dissolution, compulsory strike-off, and personal liability of the general partner.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by a Luxembourg approved statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) is required where, at the balance-sheet date, the SCSp exceeds two of the three thresholds (balance sheet total EUR 4,400,000; net turnover EUR 8,800,000; average headcount 50 employees) for two consecutive financial years; an SCSp without legal personality is generally exempt from the publication and audit obligations through the transparent-partnership exemption.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 as amended by the Law of 23 July 2016, transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS as adopted by the European Union applies if the entity opts for it or where securities are admitted to trading on an EEA-regulated market.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must file initial beneficial-owner data with the Luxembourg RBE within one month of RCS registration and must file an annual confirmation within one month after each anniversary of the latest UBO declaration. Any transfer of partnership interests, change of general partner, or alteration of the indirect ownership chain requires an updated UBO declaration within one month of the event, which restarts the twelve-month confirmation cycle. The declaration must state each individual beneficial owner's name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and the nature and extent of the beneficial interest.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (register of all limited and general partners of the SCSp)
Register of Directors (register of the managers of the corporate general partner, where applicable)
Minute Book (minutes of partner meetings, written resolutions, and general partner management decisions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,600 – 5,400 (EUR 1,500 – 5,000) per annum for a licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent or corporate secretary
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,300 – 16,200 (EUR 4,000 – 15,000) per annum for a certified statutory audit performed by a Luxembourg réviseur d'entreprises agréé

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
